definition: the skin-coloured makeup base for your face
description: At a bright vanity by a window, a friend helps a young woman with dots of foundation on her cheek, blending them into her skin with a makeup sponge. The camera shows her evenly covered face turning from side to side, and both smile into the round mirror next to bottles of foundation, saying 'That one gone, so smooth.'
